title: CarLib
description: A modular Minecraft library built for vehicles, gameplay systems, and scalable custom development.
body:
CarLib 🚗⚙️

CarLib is a modern and expandable Minecraft development library built to simplify the creation of advanced gameplay systems, especially vehicle-related mechanics and custom interactive features. Designed for developers who value clean architecture, performance, and flexibility, CarLib provides a reliable foundation for mods, plugins, and server-side projects of any scale.

Whether you're building realistic driving systems, custom transportation mechanics, or entirely new gameplay experiences, CarLib offers reusable utilities and modular APIs that reduce repetitive code and speed up development. Its lightweight structure makes integration simple while remaining powerful enough to support large and complex projects.

CarLib focuses on developer experience by offering organized systems, optimized backend handling, and scalable tools that can easily adapt to different Minecraft environments. From movement handling and entity utilities to configurable mechanics and framework-style support, the library is designed to help creators spend less time rebuilding core systems and more time creating unique experiences.

Built with maintainability and extensibility in mind, CarLib can serve as the “engine under the hood” for ambitious Minecraft projects, powering everything from simple gameplay enhancements to full-scale custom servers.

Features
🚘 Vehicle and transportation system utilities
⚡ Lightweight, optimized, and scalable architecture
🧩 Modular APIs for seamless integration
🛠️ Developer-focused utility systems
🌍 Support for custom gameplay mechanics and expansions
📦 Clean structure for maintainable projects
🔧 Flexible configuration and extensibility
